subject: Request: Rebaseline MAP & evaluation timeline due to SOC evidence request
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: Rebaseline MAP & evaluation timeline due to SOC evidence request

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the heads-up earlier. We reviewed the SOC evidence items your security team requested (log retention snippets and service account mapping) and confirmed that delivering a targeted sample set will take our infra/ops team ~3 weeks to compile and redact for third-party review.

Given Acadia's evaluation runbook and the remaining canary tests, that shift pushes the earliest meaningful QA/UX evaluation out by about 4–5 weeks. To keep expectations aligned I attached a proposed rebaseline of the MAP (Acadia_MAP_v3.xlsx) that shifts the Final Eval gate from 2028-02-28 to 2028-04-04 and adds two interim shadow tests we can run in parallel.

High-level ask: please confirm whether Acadia is comfortable with the proposed revised milestones, and whether Procurement wants the revised PO dates reflected before we send a formal MAP update.

If you prefer, we can also do a 30-minute sync to walk through the new milestones and the sample SOC evidence bundle we plan to deliver. Proposed times: Thu 1/19 11am ET or Fri 1/20 9am ET.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — we want to minimize disruption to your evaluation while staying compliant with your security controls.

Attachment: Acadia_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with rebaseline and shadow test plan)

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0183
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acadiahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <acq@acadiahealth.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jan 2028 10:05:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Rebaseline MAP & evaluation timeline due to SOC evidence request

Dylan —

Thanks for the quick note and the draft MAP. We do need the SOC samples to close the security assessment — agreed that redaction will take time. The new dates you propose look reasonable from the Security side.

A couple of items from Procurement: 1) will Redwood accept a delayed invoicing schedule if the final PO has a later effective date? 2) Acadia's legal may request an evaluation credit for the extended testing window (historically Procurement asks for a 10–20% evaluation credit when vendor-delivered delays create a material runout).

We can do Thu 1/19 11am ET for the walkthrough — I'll confirm attendees from Security and Legal.

Emily
Emily Stone
Director of Technology Evaluation | Acadia Health
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jan 2028 14:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Rebaseline MAP & evaluation timeline due to SOC evidence request

Internal note — planning options before the 11am sync:

- Credit posture: Sales can offer a one-time evaluation credit. Range to propose: 10% (standard) — up to 20% (exception) if legal/procurement push hard. Anything above 15% will need manager (Marissa) sign-off.
- Canaries: recommend we keep one rolling canary on a reserved shard to limit any customer-facing risk; that helps shorten the perceived evaluation duration. Ops confirms we can spin that up with 1 extra GPU node.
- SOC bundle: Ops can deliver a redacted sample (redwood-soc2-logs-sample.pdf) in 3 weeks if we prioritize it; include a short attestation note for Security.

If Emily pushes for immediate credit expectations in the sync, propose starting at 12% and follow up with an approval request afterward. I'll draft a short approval note to Marissa if needed.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <acq@acadiahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jan 2028 09:00:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Rebaseline MAP & evaluation timeline due to SOC evidence request

Emily —

Thanks again for the sync today. Per discussion, attached is the updated MAP that reflects: 1) Final Eval moved to 2028-04-04; 2) Two interim shadow tests on 2028-03-01 and 2028-03-18; 3) a one-time evaluation credit placeholder at 12% (subject to Redwood approval).

Next steps for alignment:
- Acadia to confirm acceptance of the rebaseline and the shadow-test cadence by close of business 1/24.
- Procurement to confirm whether the PO effective date will be adjusted or if invoice timing needs to remain as-is.
- Redwood (Ops) will deliver the redacted SOC sample in three weeks and post the attestation note to the shared drive.

DocuSign link for the MAP amendment (non-binding acceptance + updated dates): https://www.docusign.net/commit/XYZ123

Attachment: Acadia_MAP_v3.xlsx

If Procurement wants a formal SOW amendment we can route that immediately after confirmation.

Best,
Dylan
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jan 2028 16:15:00 -0500
Subject: Internal: Approval request — Acadia credit and MAP rebaseline (summary)

Folks — quick summary and approval path following Acadia's confirmation: they verbally accepted the rebaseline and indicated Procurement will respond formally by EOB 1/24 (waiting on PO dates). They also signaled they'd push back if the credit is less than 15%.

Action requests: 1) Dylan — if Procurement pushes for >12% credit, escalate to Marissa for approval (I can draft the escalation note). 2) Ben — please prepare the short manager approval note (I need that by 1/25 10am ET so I can route). 3) Ops — prioritize the SOC sample delivery; confirm ETA to me in writing so we can include it in the amendment.

I'll hold on sending the formal approval ask to Marissa until we see Procurement's reply. If Acadia insists on 20% we'll need a clear compensating concession (shorter support window or reduced scope during evaluation).

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
